name: Valproic acid
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Enzyme inducers (phenytoin, carbamazepine, phenobarbital, primidone, rifampin, ritonavir)
key_interactions.action: Monitor valproate and co-drug levels when added or stopped.

key_interactions.effect: Clinically significant fall in valproate levels; loss of seizure control (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor valproate levels frequently after starting the carbapenem; consider another antibiotic or anticonvulsant if levels drop or seizures worsen.
Reduce the lamotrigine dose (see the lamotrigine label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Diazepam, phenytoin, warfarin, amitriptyline/nortriptyline, zidovudine, propofol
key_interactions.effect: Valproate alters their levels or binding (label).
key_interactions.action: Dose adjustment may be needed; monitor.
